test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

(i) Some of the dance forms taught in all the dance classes of Delhi are Hip- Hop, Contemporary and Kathakali.

(ii) None of the dance classes of Delhi teach Kuchipudi.

(iii) Some of the dance classes of Delhi teach Salsa and Odissi.

**Conclusions:**

 (i) Salsa is taught in every dance class of Delhi .

 (ii) Some of the dance classes of Delhi do not teach Kathakali

 (iii) There isn't a single dance class in Delhi that doesn't teach Hip-Hop .
solution:
Given,

Statement:

(i) Some of the dance forms taught in all the dance classes of Delhi are Hip-Hop, Contemporary, and Kathakali.

(ii) None of the dance classes of Delhi teach Kuchipudi.

(iii) Some of the dance classes of Delhi teach Salsa and Odissi.

Conclusions:

I. Salsa is taught in every dance class of Delhi - **False** (Because, it is mentioned that only some of the dance classes of Delhi teach Salsa, not all).

II. Some of the dance classes of Delhi do not teach Kathakali - False (Because, nothing discussed about the dance Kathakali in the statement).

III. There isn’t a single dance class in Delhi that doesn’t teach Hip-Hop - **True **(Because, it is mentioned that Some of the dance forms taught in all the dance classes of Delhi are Hip-Hop, Contemporary, and Kathakali).

So, only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
